name: badgy
description: Badgy — an installable attendance calendar for planning office time against a rolling badge-in compliance score. Client-only SPA; data syncs privately to each user's OneDrive.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && vitest run tools
scripts.gates: npm run gen:data && npm run lint && npm run lint:css && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
